text:
maria: Quick idea 1: run a 4-week "Lightning Labs" sequence for the tiny-starterkit OSS refapp: weekly 30-min office hours + a 20-min lightning workshop slot for meetups. aim: low-friction onboarding + lead capture.

kai: love it. goal metrics? signups, star count, repo clones, and webinar leads. also short videos for socials.

sara: i'll own content ops. deliverables per week: landing + one tutorial (5-7 steps), a 10-slide meetup deck, 2 short clips (60s), and a benchmark blurb.

maria: i'll handle copy + socials. need a template for CTAs and a landing page pattern. recommend single form for the series with checkboxes for which weeks people want.

leo: engineering support: can provide a prebuilt Codespace + tiny dataset for hands-on. also can export a benchmark notebook trimmed for a 2-slide perf callout. p95 and cost estimates only.

sara: suggested schedule: Week 1: Quickstart & demo. Week 2: Integrations (embeddings + search). Week 3: Performance tuning + quantization notes. Week 4: Workshop + community QA. each session 30m office hours (open) + 20m workshop at the end.

kai: inbound routing: single HubSpot form -> tag by week selections -> route to devrel nurture. UTMs: utm_source=lightning_labs&utm_medium=landing&utm_campaign=tiny_starterkit_ll.

maria: messaging notes for landing hero: "Get started with tiny-starterkit: deploy a refapp in 5 minutes, compare perf & cost, run community labs." short subhead: "Weekly hands-on labs + office hours." CTA: "Join a lab"

sara: i'll draft the tutorial templates. quick snippet idea for the landing:
```bash
# quickstart
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/tiny-starterkit.git
cd tiny-starterkit
./quickstart.sh --demo
```

leo: bench preview: p50=90ms p95=230ms tokens=512 cost_est=$0.20/1k on dedicated-small with batching. i'll run a trimmed suite and drop the notebook link.

kai: for meetup kit: create slides + a one-pager with step-by-step setup + a tiny dataset and a checked Codespace. label assets with version and hash.

maria: social plan: 3 posts per week during campaign: announce, reminder (mid-week), last-call. turn clips into X/Twitter and LinkedIn short posts. craft 2 pillar threads for devs.

sara: follow-ups: immediate email with repo + quickstart, day-3 drip with tips + benchmark, week-2 deep-dive invite, and a final wrap with highlights + community badge.

kai: automation: webhook payload for form (example):
```json
{"email":"{email}","name":"{name}","weeks":["week1","week2"],"utm":"{utm_campaign}"}
```

leo: ops note: record office hours and auto-generate clips using the in-house clipper. will store assets in /s3/marketing/lightning_labs/<date>.

maria: booking: want to run Week 1 next Tue 11am PT. sara can run the tutorial; leo provides Codespace link; kai will wire the form. is that doable?

sara: yes. i'll publish the tutorial draft by Mon EOD.

kai: form + HubSpot flow ready by Mon morning. i'll set tags: lightning_labs, tiny_starterkit, week1.

devrel-bot: Checklist created: [lightning-labs-tiny-starterkit] - landing page, hubspot form, codespace, tutorial week1, bench notebook, meetup deck, social clips. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/launch-checklists/lightning-labs

maria: perfect. once week1 assets are live i'll open a PR for socials + syndication. ping here with final Codespace link and recorded clip. :zap:
